items.title: Lionel Reason Interview, 1981-05-26
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, well, I don't know, he said he had to take a disc or something out of his neck.

ctx.x: Thing, you know, along. Did you know him?

Yes, he's been along. He's got operating on. Yeah. He seems to have left Thomas now. He left T. Thomas' band, I think. Well, he got operating on. Yeah, I know, but I don't know who the new drummer is. He's from Reserve, I think.
Yeah, well, I don't know, he said he had to take a disc or something out of his neck.
